comparison.objective: Arrange a plant specimen and labels correctly on a herbarium sheet.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle planar placement and orientation of a specimen and paper slips.
comparison.success_condition: Roots face down, label is bottom-right, and determination slip is above it; detailed attachment/scoring thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Delicate sheet layout does not exercise tool engagement, mechanical retention, torque control, or dynamic commissioning.
